relics.name: Ashen Signet
relics.effect: Once per table, after the caster wins as sole winner of an eligible contested showdown pot following their own legal preflop raise, gain +1 Aether after regular regeneration, capped at 3. Cannot trigger more than once per table.

relics.name: Veiled Monocle
relics.effect: The first Unmask-family spell cast each table costs 1 less Aether, min 0. Only affects the spell instance actually cast; excludes Ravenous Eye exhaust removal rules.

relics.name: Thorn Anchor
relics.effect: The first Briar-family cast each table costs 1 less Aether, min 0. The pot-limit ceiling still applies equally to every seat.

relics.name: Lantern Reservoir
relics.effect: At each new table, initialize owner's Aether at min(3, base table-entry Aether + 1). Does not provide chips or raise the 3-Aether cap.

relics.name: Mirror Prism
relics.effect: The first Fate Exchange-family cast each table costs 1 less Aether, min 0. Does not permit an additional cast or extra exchanged cards.

relics.name: Gambler's Knot
relics.effect: Once per table, after owner legally folds facing a positive outstanding wager, gain +1 Aether capped at 3. Never triggers on a check or folded seat action outside legal turn.

covenants.name: Covenant of the Open Book
covenants.acquisition: optional event node; transfer 22 Lifechips to named Witness escrow; item not for sale at regular shop
covenants.effect: At the opening of each poker hand owner gains +1 Aether capped at 3. Immediately after dealing hole cards and before opening magic windows, reveal a uniformly random one of owner's two hole cards PUBLICLY to the whole table. If Fate Exchange replaces that revealed slot, update the public revealed identity immediately to the replacement; the currently publicly known card is never concealed by exchange.
covenants.limitations: No extra casts; 3 Aether hard cap; public tell in hand history; does not modify pot or ranking
